title: Flow Node Rendering Cleanup
description: Refactor flow node rendering: map widgets to native DAG node kinds, remove overlay, fix label centering and handle overlap, LOD-driven progressive disclosure.
summary: Computation nodes now use a clean three-column layout: input channel labels on the left, output channel labels on the right, vertical name centered (bottom-to-top). Removed section and row dividers. Channel labels use dedicated left/right column positions via computation_column_center_x. Layout appears at Normal+ zoom (shows_computation_layout). Ghost node preview matches. WASM rebuilt for @dag/core and @flow/core. All dag (20) and flow (15) tests pass.
